title: pteridium aquilinum var. pinetorum
intro: Pteridium aquilinum var. pinetorum, commonly known as Mountain Brake Fern, is a variety of the Bracken Fern, a type of flowering plant in the fern family (Dryopteridaceae). It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which can help alleviate conditions such as arthritis, wounds, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Brake Fern include modulating immune responses, reducing pain and inflammation, and exhibiting antioxidant activities, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Brake Fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its therapeutic effects.
